comments.body: ## Pitch at ACD before Feb 4th @jihoonsong recommend that FOCIL add a 2 minute pitch at ACD to follow the process https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8081-hegota-network-upgrade-meta-thread/26876 From: https://forkcast.org/calls/acdc/173/#t=1704 ACDE #229 is the last ACD before the deadline: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1883 Note: EIP-8105 encrypted transaction pools, another potential headliner has already asked to pitch as per the process. https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1883#issuecomment-3791556724

I'm still keen to see opposers rebutted and thoughts on delivering Hegotá in 2026 with FOCIL as part of the campaign to have FOCIL as the headliner.

https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/focil-readiness-for-hegota/27245/2?u=abcoathup
